notes.subject: mugan/tan/dege-ni-tan/mugan
notes.rationale: Verse counts harvest yields — twenty→ten, fifty→twenty — a ledger of loss.

notes.subject: puura
notes.rationale: פורה (wine-press measure) appears only here in the Tanakh.

notes.subject: puura
notes.rationale: Read as a vessel/measure (fifty purim) or the press itself; kept as measure-name, un-translated.

notes.subject: היקב
notes.rationale: Wine-vat rendered diwɛn-bilanlan (wine-holding hollow), joining the dug-trough picture.

notes.subject: עשרים…עשרה…עשרים
notes.rationale: Falling number-rhetoric frames the verse (20→10, 50→20), the loss itself counted.

translation: Tuma bɛɛ, ni mɔgɔ na ⟨ɛ⟩ kisɛ-dɔgɔ mugan ɲɛ, a ye tan dɔrɔn ye; ni mɔgɔ na diwɛn-bilanlan kɔnɔ walasa ka puura dege-ni-tan bō, a ye mugan dɔrɔn ye.
